name: Bogborn
summary: Towering troll-like folk of the Zulrogg mire, 7 to 8 feet tall, who mark prey with swamp magic and knit their wounds with their own vigour.

traits.name: Bog Bulk
traits.summary: Advantage on ability checks to end the Grappled condition; you count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
traits.text: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 60 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Guiding Bond
traits.summary: Bonus Action: mark a creature you see within 60 feet for 1 minute; add 1d4 to your ability checks and attack rolls against it. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you magically mark a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The mark lasts 1 minute and looks like ephemeral plants, moss, fungus or swamp animals that only you can see. While it lasts you add 1d4 to ability checks and attack rolls you make against the marked creature. You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: You gain proficiency in Perception or Survival (your choice).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Bonus Action: spend a Hit Point Die, roll it and regain that + Constitution modifier (minimum 1) Hit Points. Acid or Fire damage switches it off until the end of your next turn.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll it, and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). If you take Acid or Fire damage, this trait does not function until the end of your next turn.
